status: Exploratory protocol fixed before inspecting semantic retrieval outcomes; all three families are pilot-only.
questions: Do semantic actions create real-query selection headroom?
Do document-generated probe contrasts support source-trained routing improvements on another corpus?
Can source-trained one-step utility selection outperform random, fixed-coverage, and Gaussian-information-gain selection?

document_split.implementation: Inherited unchanged from pilot/data.py; SHA256 duplicate-group assignment, seed 20260909, exploration probability 0.2; full corpus remains indexed.
document_split.eligibility: All judged documents must exist and every positive support document must belong to the held-out document pool.
document_split.distribution_limit: Especially severe query retention in NFCorpus (65/323 test). Results apply to retained queries; no claim about full test-distribution quality or entity disjointness.

query_selection.implementation: Inherited select_ids: deterministic ID hash, train-20260909 / test-20260909 salts.
query_selection.source_partition_rule: First floor(2n/3) selected IDs train; split remaining IDs equally into calibration and utility, with odd remainder in utility.

retrieval.unit: Three corpus families, each with two correlated backend configurations.

generation.sampling: Greedy local MLX; batch size 8; max output 300 rewrite / 192 probe tokens.
generation.actions: Original and inherited lexical keywords; query-only semantic rewrite, synthetic hypothetical passage, and two-subquery reciprocal-rank fusion (k=60). All semantic outputs share one generation response.
generation.failure_policy: No repair, retries, lexical fallback, or task deletion. A malformed/invalid response makes all three generated actions unavailable; choosing one receives empty retrieval and zero task utility.
generation.validity: Format validation is not a semantic-faithfulness guarantee. HyDE requested 40-60 words, hard valid range 20-100 with warnings outside request; passages are synthetic retrieval representations, never evidence.

probes.sampling: Sort exploration IDs, shuffle with Python random.Random(seed), take first 16. Deduplicate generation across overlapping pools but charge logical costs in each pool.
probes.construction: Document-only question pair generation followed by a separate query-only rewrite call for each valid question; no document passed to the rewriter.
probes.pairs: Original versus each of four alternatives, sharing the same inspected candidate pool across selectors.
probes.preflight_exclusions: Invalid generation or exactly identical original/alternative query text; decisions made before observing search outcomes.
probes.observation: Known sampled-document reciprocal-rank delta, overlap, and per-action reciprocal rank; not complete relevance judgments.
probes.selector_visibility: Family, action, bucket, eight query features, pair search cost; numerical history. No unselected outcomes, text, document IDs, or real target queries/labels.
probes.candidate_id: Opaque hash; may be used for deterministic tie breaking only.

training.folds: Leave one corpus out, using both other corpora as source. Fit separately by known backend. All configurations of a corpus stay in the same role.
training.router: Choose source-train mean fixed scores or StandardScaler+Ridge(alpha=10 or 100), using equally averaged source-calibration nDCG@10; eight lexical features plus 384 frozen query-encoder features.
training.profile: Numerical count,sum,sumsq in 2 families x 4 query buckets x 4 alternative actions; shrunk means with pseudocount 4.
training.calibrator: Per-action Ridge(alpha=10, fit_intercept=false) predicts action-original real utility residual from global and bucket probe deltas in each family. Fit only source calibration tasks; repeated histories weight each source task total 1.
training.source_histories: All three source pools, random prefixes [0,4,8,16,32], seed first eight hex digits of SHA256('source_history|environment_name|pool_seed').
training.selector_labels: One-step change in frozen calibrated router's mean source utility-task nDCG after a candidate observation; utility tasks disjoint from router train and calibration IDs.
training.value_features: Family/action/bucket one-hots; 8 query features; 32 logcounts,32 shrunk means,32 variances; log total count and pair cost. Prediction divided by search cost.
training.information_gain: Independent Gaussian cell model with source between-environment cell-mean variance as prior, source marginal contrast variance as noise; both floored at 0.01. Gaussian information gain divided by search cost; heuristic model, not calibrated confidence.
training.target_random_seed: First eight hex digits of SHA256('target|pool_seed').

comparisons.shared_components: Same base router, profile, calibrator, candidate pool, and pair-budget schedule. Selectors differ only in acquisition.
comparisons.fixed: Balance observed family/bucket/action cell counts, then deterministic cell and candidate ID order.
comparisons.oracle_visibility: Evaluator-only; no target label access in onboarding or fitting.

outcomes_and_costs.primary: Real-query nDCG@10, per corpus/backend with paired query and seed deltas; equal-family aggregation descriptive only.
outcomes_and_costs.setup: Budget zero bypasses pool construction. Every positive-budget method pays all 16 sampled document inspections and every question/rewrite generation in the full inspected pool, including unselected/invalid candidates.
outcomes_and_costs.onboarding: Charge every selected pair's search count: 2 normally, 3 for decomposition. Cached and reused original results do not make virtual interactions free.
outcomes_and_costs.serving: Original/keywords cost one search, semantic/HyDE one, decomposition two. Any generated action pays one full shared rewrite response; unavailable generated action still pays generation and zero searches. This is conservative logical single-action serving accounting.
outcomes_and_costs.budget_limit: Equal probe counts do not ensure equal total search or generation cost. Report actual costs and do not claim cost dominance from count-matched results.
outcomes_and_costs.offline: Full action/outcome caches, corpus indexing and source fitting are experiment infrastructure, reported separately from deployment costs.
outcomes_and_costs.uncertainty: Paired descriptive intervals conditional on these families, selected queries and three adaptation seeds; no family-population guarantee.

not_established: validated semantic equivalence of every rewrite
probe reward alignment with real tasks
novelty relative to all prior work
